references.text: The census of the tribe of Reuben is mentioned here with the number 46,500, which is part of the total number for Reuben's camp.
The census of the tribe of Simeon (59,300) included in the total count of Reuben's camp.
The census of the tribe of Gad (45,650), which is the third tribe in Reuben's camp.
The detailed listing of Reuben's camp with the three tribes Reuben, Simeon, and Gad, summed up in verse 16.
The description of how Reuben's camp broke camp and marched as the second group, as established in chapter 2.
Parallel to the total number of Judah's camp (186,400) which set out first, while Reuben's camp set out second.
